steps: 1. A net is a 2D flat pattern that folds into a 3D solid without overlapping
2. Rectangular prism net has 6 rectangular faces in 3 congruent opposite pairs
3. Surface Area is the total sum of the areas of all flat faces on the net

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Cookie Houses
revealWordProblem.text:
A cookie house building kit contains three different cookie house kits. The finished houses are labeled A, B, and C, and the flat cookie pieces that fold up to make them are labeled 1, 2, and 3.
Question: Which flat kit matches which cookie house? Explain your reasoning.
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: Three finished cookie houses labeled A, B, and C beside three flat nets labeled 1, 2, and 3.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: House A matches kit 3: the square base and four triangular faces fold into a square pyramid. House B matches kit 1: the two triangular ends and three rectangular faces form a triangular prism. House C matches kit 2: six rectangular faces form a rectangular prism. Check both the face shapes and how their edges meet when each net folds; counting faces alone is not enough to verify a net.

questions.stem: A time capsule box is a rectangular prism with l = 6 in, w = 4 in, h = 2 in. What is its surface area?
choiceFeedback: Remember each face has a matching opposite face — double the sum of the three face areas.
That's the volume — surface area needs the sum of all six face areas, not length × width × height.
Check the units — surface area covers a flat surface, so it needs square units, not cubic.
hints: Surface area covers all 6 faces of the 6 × 4 × 2 box — it's not the same as the space inside.
Use SA = 2lw + 2lh + 2wh: find the three different face areas, double each, and add.
Start with the top face: 6 × 4 = 24 in². Then find 6 × 2 and 4 × 2 before doubling and adding.
questions.stemEs: Una caja para cápsula del tiempo es un prisma rectangular con l = 6 in, w = 4 in, h = 2 in. ¿Cuál es el área de su superficie?
hintsEs: El área superficial cubre las 6 caras de la caja de 6 × 4 × 2: no es lo mismo que el espacio de adentro.
Usa AS = 2la + 2lh + 2ah: halla las tres áreas de cara distintas, duplica cada una y suma.
Empieza con la cara de arriba: 6 × 4 = 24 pulg². Luego halla 6 × 2 y 4 × 2 antes de duplicar y sumar.

questions.stem: How many faces does a rectangular prism have?
questions.explanation: A rectangular prism has 6 faces: top, bottom, front, back, left, and right.
choiceFeedback: Don't forget the top and bottom — a box has faces all around it, not just the sides.
That's the number of corners (vertices), not the number of flat faces.
That's the number of edges, not the number of flat faces — count the flat surfaces instead.
hints: Picture a cereal box in your hands. Turn it: there's a front, a back, two sides, a top, and a bottom.
Count faces in opposite pairs — every face on a rectangular prism has a matching partner across from it.
Count the pairs: top/bottom is one pair, front/back is another, left/right is the third. Multiply pairs by 2.
questions.explanationEs: Un prisma rectangular tiene 6 caras: arriba, abajo, adelante, atrás, izquierda y derecha.
hintsEs: Imagina una caja de cereal en tus manos. Gírala: hay un frente, una parte trasera, dos lados, una tapa y una base.
Cuenta las caras en pares opuestos — cada cara de un prisma rectangular tiene una pareja igual del otro lado.
Cuenta los pares: arriba/abajo es un par, frente/atrás es otro, izquierda/derecha es el tercero. Multiplica los pares por 2.

questions.stem: Surface area is measured in which type of unit?
questions.explanation: Surface area measures flat surfaces, so it uses square units. Volume uses cubic units.
choiceFeedback: Cubic units measure 3D volume, not a flat surface — surface area needs a different kind of unit.
Linear units only measure length in one direction — surface area covers a flat region, needing two dimensions.
Every measurement needs a unit — think about what kind of unit matches a flat, two-dimensional surface.
hints: Surface area measures the flat covering on the outside of a solid — like wrapping paper.
Flat 2D measurements use square units. Save cubic units for filling space and plain units for length.
Imagine covering one face with 1-inch squares. Each square is 1 in² — that's the kind of unit surface area counts.
questions.stemEs: ¿Con qué tipo de unidad se mide el área de la superficie?
questions.explanationEs: El área de la superficie mide superficies planas, así que usa unidades cuadradas. El volumen usa unidades cúbicas.
hintsEs: El área superficial mide la cubierta plana del exterior de un sólido, como el papel de regalo.
Las medidas planas 2D usan unidades cuadradas. Guarda las cúbicas para llenar espacio y las simples para longitud.
Imagina cubrir una cara con cuadrados de 1 pulgada. Cada cuadrado es 1 pulg²: ese es el tipo de unidad que cuenta el área superficial.

steps: 1. A net is a 2D flat pattern that folds into a 3D solid without overlapping
2. Rectangular prism net has 6 rectangular faces in 3 congruent opposite pairs
3. Surface Area is the total sum of the areas of all flat faces on the net
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Surface Area Using Nets is finding the area of only one face from each of the 3 matching pairs and forgetting to double it, instead of counting all 6 faces. For a box that is 9 in × 4 in × 5 in, a student might add just one face from each pair: (9×4) + (9×5) + (4×5) = 36 + 45 + 20 = 101 in², but the net actually has two of each face, so the correct total is 2(36) + 2(45) + 2(20) = 72 + 90 + 40 = 202 in² — exactly double. Before you submit, ask: 'Did I count both matching faces in each pair, or only one from each pair?'

level1.stem: A box is 3 in long, 3 in wide, and 1 in tall. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Una caja mide 3 pulg de largo, 3 pulg de ancho y 1 pulg de alto. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Find each pair of faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right.
hintsEs: Halla cada par de caras: arriba y abajo, frente y atrás, izquierda y derecha.
level1.explanation: Find each pair of faces: 2 × (3 × 3) = 18; 2 × (3 × 1) = 6; 2 × (3 × 1) = 6 Add the three pairs: 18 + 6 + 6 = 30
level1.explanationEs: Halla cada par de caras: 2 × (3 × 3) = 18; 2 × (3 × 1) = 6; 2 × (3 × 1) = 6 Suma los tres pares: 18 + 6 + 6 = 30

level1.stem: A cube has edges of 2 cm. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Un cubo tiene aristas de 2 cm. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: A cube has 6 faces, and they are all the same square.
hintsEs: Un cubo tiene 6 caras, y todas son el mismo cuadrado.
level1.explanation: Find the area of one face: 2 × 2 = 4 Multiply by the 6 faces: 6 × 4 = 24
level1.explanationEs: Halla el área de una cara: 2 × 2 = 4 Multiplica por las 6 caras: 6 × 4 = 24

level1.stem: A box is 6 cm long, 2 cm wide, and 2 cm tall. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Una caja mide 6 cm de largo, 2 cm de ancho y 2 cm de alto. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Find the area of each pair of faces. Then add.
hintsEs: Halla el área de cada par de caras. Luego suma.
level1.explanation: Find each pair of faces: 2 × (6 × 2) = 24; 2 × (6 × 2) = 24; 2 × (2 × 2) = 8 Add the three pairs: 24 + 24 + 8 = 56
level1.explanationEs: Halla cada par de caras: 2 × (6 × 2) = 24; 2 × (6 × 2) = 24; 2 × (2 × 2) = 8 Suma los tres pares: 24 + 24 + 8 = 56

level1.stem: A box is 5 cm long, 2 cm wide, and 1 cm tall. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Una caja mide 5 cm de largo, 2 cm de ancho y 1 cm de alto. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Find the area of each pair of faces. Then add the three pairs.
hintsEs: Halla el área de cada par de caras. Luego suma los tres pares.
level1.explanation: Find each pair of faces: 2 × (5 × 2) = 20; 2 × (5 × 1) = 10; 2 × (2 × 1) = 4 Add the three pairs: 20 + 10 + 4 = 34
level1.explanationEs: Halla cada par de caras: 2 × (5 × 2) = 20; 2 × (5 × 1) = 10; 2 × (2 × 1) = 4 Suma los tres pares: 20 + 10 + 4 = 34

level1.stem: A box is 9 in long, 6 in wide, and 4 in tall. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Una caja mide 9 pulg de largo, 6 pulg de ancho y 4 pulg de alto. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: The box has 3 pairs of matching faces. Find one face in each pair, then double it.
hintsEs: La caja tiene 3 pares de caras iguales. Halla una cara de cada par y luego duplícala.
level1.explanation: Find the top and bottom: 2 × (9 × 6) = 108 Find the front and back: 2 × (9 × 4) = 72 Find the left and right: 2 × (6 × 4) = 48 Add the three pairs: 108 + 72 + 48 = 228
level1.explanationEs: Halla la de arriba y la de abajo: 2 × (9 × 6) = 108 Halla la del frente y la de atrás: 2 × (9 × 4) = 72 Halla la izquierda y la derecha: 2 × (6 × 4) = 48 Suma los tres pares: 108 + 72 + 48 = 228

level2.stem: Jin finds the surface area of a box that is 7 cm by 4 cm by 2 cm. He writes 28 + 14 + 8 = 50. Is he right? What is the surface area?
level2.stemEs: Jin halla el área de superficie de una caja de 7 cm por 4 cm por 2 cm. Escribe 28 + 14 + 8 = 50. ¿Tiene razón? ¿Cuál es el área de superficie?
hints: Count the faces on a net of a box. How many faces did Jin add?
hintsEs: Cuenta las caras de la plantilla de una caja. ¿Cuántas caras sumó Jin?
level2.explanation: Count the faces Jin added: 3 faces, not 6 Double each face area: 2 × 28 = 56; 2 × 14 = 28; 2 × 8 = 16 Add the three pairs: 56 + 28 + 16 = 100
level2.explanationEs: Cuenta las caras que sumó Jin: 3 caras, no 6 Duplica el área de cada cara: 2 × 28 = 56; 2 × 14 = 28; 2 × 8 = 16 Suma los tres pares: 56 + 28 + 16 = 100

level2.stem: A box is 4.5 cm long, 2 cm wide, and 3 cm tall. Find its surface area.
level2.stemEs: Una caja mide 4.5 cm de largo, 2 cm de ancho y 3 cm de alto. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: A decimal edge does not change the steps. Find each pair, then add.
hintsEs: Una arista decimal no cambia los pasos. Halla cada par y luego suma.
level2.explanation: Find each pair of faces: 2 × (4.5 × 2) = 18; 2 × (4.5 × 3) = 27; 2 × (2 × 3) = 12 Add the three pairs: 18 + 27 + 12 = 57
level2.explanationEs: Halla cada par de caras: 2 × (4.5 × 2) = 18; 2 × (4.5 × 3) = 27; 2 × (2 × 3) = 12 Suma los tres pares: 18 + 27 + 12 = 57

level2.stem: A box is 6 ft long, 5 ft wide, and 3 ft tall. Find its surface area.
level2.stemEs: Una caja mide 6 pies de largo, 5 pies de ancho y 3 pies de alto. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Find the area of each pair of faces. Then add.
hintsEs: Halla el área de cada par de caras. Luego suma.
level2.explanation: Find each pair of faces: 2 × (6 × 5) = 60; 2 × (6 × 3) = 36; 2 × (5 × 3) = 30 Add the three pairs: 60 + 36 + 30 = 126
level2.explanationEs: Halla cada par de caras: 2 × (6 × 5) = 60; 2 × (6 × 3) = 36; 2 × (5 × 3) = 30 Suma los tres pares: 60 + 36 + 30 = 126

level2.stem: A cube-shaped box needs 216 square inches of paper to cover it with no overlap. How long is each edge?
level2.stemEs: Una caja con forma de cubo necesita 216 pulgadas cuadradas de papel para cubrirla sin superponerse. ¿Cuánto mide cada arista?
hints: Find the area of one face first. Then think: which number times itself gives that area?
hintsEs: Primero halla el área de una cara. Luego piensa: ¿qué número multiplicado por sí mismo da esa área?
level2.explanation: Find the area of one face: 216 ÷ 6 = 36 Find the side of that square: 6 × 6 = 36 Check with the surface area: 6 × 36 = 216
level2.explanationEs: Halla el área de una cara: 216 ÷ 6 = 36 Halla el lado de ese cuadrado: 6 × 6 = 36 Comprueba con el área de superficie: 6 × 36 = 216

level2.stem: A gift box is 10 in long, 10 in wide, and 3 in tall. How much wrapping paper covers it with no overlap?
level2.stemEs: Una caja de regalo mide 10 pulg de largo, 10 pulg de ancho y 3 pulg de alto. ¿Cuánto papel de regalo la cubre sin superponerse?
hints: The paper covers all 6 faces. The top and bottom are squares.
hintsEs: El papel cubre las 6 caras. La de arriba y la de abajo son cuadrados.
level2.explanation: Find the top and bottom: 2 × (10 × 10) = 200 Find the four sides: 2 × (10 × 3) = 60; 2 × (10 × 3) = 60 Add all the faces: 200 + 60 + 60 = 320
level2.explanationEs: Halla la de arriba y la de abajo: 2 × (10 × 10) = 200 Halla los cuatro lados: 2 × (10 × 3) = 60; 2 × (10 × 3) = 60 Suma todas las caras: 200 + 60 + 60 = 320

level3.stem: A net folds into a rectangular prism. How many rectangular faces does that net have?
choiceFeedback: That counts only the four side faces, leaving out the top and the bottom.
A rectangular prism has 8 vertices, but the net shows its flat faces. Count those.
A rectangular prism has 12 edges, but the net shows its flat faces. Count those.
level3.explanation: A rectangular prism has 6 faces — top and bottom, front and back, and two ends — so its net shows all 6.

level3.stem: Kim says boxes with the same volume need the same paper. Box A is 3 in × 3 in × 4 in. Box B is 9 in × 4 in × 1 in. Both hold 36 cubic inches. How much more paper does B need?
level3.stemEs: Kim dice que las cajas con el mismo volumen necesitan el mismo papel. La caja A mide 3 pulg × 3 pulg × 4 pulg. La caja B mide 9 pulg × 4 pulg × 1 pulg. Las dos contienen 36 pulgadas cúbicas. ¿Cuánto papel más necesita B?
hints: Find the surface area of each box. Then subtract.
hintsEs: Halla el área de superficie de cada caja. Luego resta.
level3.explanation: Find the surface area of Box A: 2 × 9 + 2 × 12 + 2 × 12 = 66 Find the surface area of Box B: 2 × 36 + 2 × 9 + 2 × 4 = 98 Subtract: 98 − 66 = 32
level3.explanationEs: Halla el área de superficie de la caja A: 2 × 9 + 2 × 12 + 2 × 12 = 66 Halla el área de superficie de la caja B: 2 × 36 + 2 × 9 + 2 × 4 = 98 Resta: 98 − 66 = 32

level3.stem: A cube has a surface area of 384 square centimeters. How long is each edge?
level3.stemEs: Un cubo tiene un área de superficie de 384 centímetros cuadrados. ¿Cuánto mide cada arista?
hints: All 6 faces are the same square. Find one face first.
hintsEs: Las 6 caras son el mismo cuadrado. Primero halla una cara.
level3.explanation: Find the area of one face: 384 ÷ 6 = 64 Find the side of that square: 8 × 8 = 64
level3.explanationEs: Halla el área de una cara: 384 ÷ 6 = 64 Halla el lado de ese cuadrado: 8 × 8 = 64

level3.stem: A tissue box is 5 in long, 5 in wide, and 6 in tall. It has a 2 in by 3 in hole in the top. How much cardboard does the box use?
level3.stemEs: Una caja de pañuelos mide 5 pulg de largo, 5 pulg de ancho y 6 pulg de alto. Tiene un agujero de 2 pulg por 3 pulg en la tapa. ¿Cuánto cartón usa la caja?
hints: Find the surface area of the closed box. Then take away the hole.
hintsEs: Halla el área de superficie de la caja cerrada. Luego quita el agujero.
level3.explanation: Find the top and bottom: 2 × (5 × 5) = 50 Find the four sides: 4 × (5 × 6) = 120 Take away the hole: 2 × 3 = 6; 50 + 120 − 6 = 164
level3.explanationEs: Halla la de arriba y la de abajo: 2 × (5 × 5) = 50 Halla los cuatro lados: 4 × (5 × 6) = 120 Quita el agujero: 2 × 3 = 6; 50 + 120 − 6 = 164

level3.stem: A box has a square base and is 10 cm tall. Its surface area is 192 square centimeters. How long is each side of the base?
level3.stemEs: Una caja tiene una base cuadrada y mide 10 cm de alto. Su área de superficie es 192 centímetros cuadrados. ¿Cuánto mide cada lado de la base?
hints: Try a side length. Find the 2 square faces and the 4 side faces. Does the total equal 192?
hintsEs: Prueba una longitud de lado. Halla las 2 caras cuadradas y las 4 caras de los lados. ¿El total es 192?
level3.explanation: Try a side of 4 cm: 2 × (4 × 4) = 32; 4 × (4 × 10) = 160 Add and compare: 32 + 160 = 192 Check a different side: 5 → 50 + 200 = 250
level3.explanationEs: Prueba un lado de 4 cm: 2 × (4 × 4) = 32; 4 × (4 × 10) = 160 Suma y compara: 32 + 160 = 192 Comprueba otro lado: 5 → 50 + 200 = 250

tool.instructions: Fold the flat net into the solid, then unfold it again. Every face you see in the net is a face you have to add up for surface area.

question.stem: This net has 6 rectangles. What does adding all 6 of their areas give you?
choices: The surface area of the solid

steps.title: Check how the edges meet
steps.math: check face shapes AND how edges meet when folded
steps.say: Counting faces alone is not enough to check a net.

workedSteps.answer: A matches kit 3, B matches kit 1, and C matches kit 2.
